request_text: A natural photographic portrait of a fictional adult model wearing a Daoist ceremonial-style robe in a quiet stone entrance hall. The model faces the camera so the front of the robe is clearly visible, framed from head to below the knees. Gentle morning light enters through an open doorway; the pose feels relaxed and unforced.
